purpose: Measure whether a flow's grain changes outcome quality as a function of how separable the task is. The independent variable is grain: holistic (fix) versus separated (build --process high). The moderator is the task's a-priori separability band.
independent_variable: grain: holistic fix vs separated build --process high
moderator: separability band (separable | mixed | entangled), pre-registered per task
harness: node experiments/e1/run-matrix.ts --live --task <id> --repeats 5 (this set is the harness default tasks-root)
lineage_note: heldout-wrap-index and heldout-normalize-email are copied from the fix-vs-vanilla held-out set to give this experiment its separable band. They keep their ids and still live in fix-vs-vanilla too; the two sets are independent.
